title: Paulina Zelitsky's sunken city off Cuba and her arrest in Mexico

tellings.quote: So she goes to Mexico to investigate the connection. She's arrested in Mexico severely intimidated by the authorities and sent back to Canada

plain: A researcher named Paulina Zelitsky, who reported finding a sunken city on the seabed off western Cuba, is said to have gone to Mexico in the early 2010s to look into a link between the two places, and there to have been arrested, badly intimidated by the authorities and sent back to Canada. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells this on the show as something passed on from Zelitsky's own account, and he also brings up the magazine National Geographic in connection with it. Told this way, it suggests someone did not want that link looked into.
